SELECT o.id AS order_id, o.order_no, o.user_id, u.phone AS user_phone, u.nickname AS user_nickname, o.status, o.total_amount, o.expire_at, o.created_at, MIN(r.run_date) AS first_travel_date, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT t.train_no ORDER BY t.train_no SEPARATOR '/') AS train_nos, SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(fs.name ORDER BY item.id SEPARATOR ','), ',', 1) AS from_station_name, SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(ts.name ORDER BY item.id DESC SEPARATOR ','), ',', 1) AS to_station_name, COUNT(DISTINCT item.passenger_id) AS passenger_count, COUNT(DISTINCT item.id) AS ticket_count FROM ticket_order o JOIN user u ON u.id = o.user_id LEFT JOIN order_item item ON item.order_id = o.id LEFT JOIN train_run r ON r.id = item.run_id LEFT JOIN train t ON t.id = r.train_id LEFT JOIN station fs ON fs.id = item.from_station_id LEFT JOIN station ts ON ts.id = item.to_station_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND o.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{orderNo}, '%') AND o.user_id = #{userId} AND o.status = #{status}
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_item ti JOIN train_run tr ON tr.id = ti.run_id JOIN train tt ON tt.id = tr.train_id WHERE ti.order_id = o.id AND tt.train_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{trainNo}, '%'))
AND (o.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_item ki JOIN passenger p ON p.id = ki.passenger_id JOIN station kfs ON kfs.id = ki.from_station_id JOIN station kts ON kts.id = ki.to_station_id WHERE ki.order_id = o.id AND (p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR kfs.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR kts.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))))
AND o.created_at >= #{startDate} AND o.created_at < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY o.id, o.order_no, o.user_id, u.phone, u.nickname, o.status, o.total_amount, o.expire_at, o.created_at ORDER BY o.created_at DESC, o.id DESC

SELECT p.id AS payment_id, p.payment_no, p.order_id, o.order_no, o.user_id, u.phone AS user_phone, p.channel, p.amount, p.status, p.paid_at, p.created_at FROM payment_record p JOIN ticket_order o ON o.id = p.order_id JOIN user u ON u.id = o.user_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND p.payment_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{paymentNo}, '%') AND o.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{orderNo}, '%') AND p.status = #{status} AND p.channel = #{channel} AND p.created_at >= #{startDate} AND p.created_at < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC

SELECT rr.id AS refund_id, rr.refund_no, rr.return_id, rtn.return_no, rtn.order_id, o.order_no, rtn.order_item_id, rtn.user_id, u.phone AS user_phone, rtn.ticket_amount, rtn.fee_amount, rr.amount, rr.status, rr.refunded_at, rr.created_at FROM refund_record rr JOIN ticket_return rtn ON rtn.id = rr.return_id JOIN ticket_order o ON o.id = rtn.order_id JOIN user u ON u.id = rtn.user_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND rr.refund_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{refundNo}, '%') AND o.order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{orderNo}, '%') AND rr.status = #{status} AND rr.created_at >= #{startDate} AND rr.created_at < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) ORDER BY rr.created_at DESC, rr.id DESC

SELECT item.id AS order_item_id, item.run_id, t.train_no, coach.coach_no, seat.seat_no, item.from_seq, item.to_seq, COUNT(inv.id) AS occupied_segment_count, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(inv.segment_seq, ':', inv.status) ORDER BY inv.segment_seq SEPARATOR ',') AS inventory_statuses FROM order_item item JOIN train_run r ON r.id = item.run_id JOIN train t ON t.id = r.train_id LEFT JOIN train_seat seat ON seat.id = item.seat_id LEFT JOIN train_coach coach ON coach.id = seat.coach_id LEFT JOIN seat_segment_inventory inv ON inv.order_item_id = item.id WHERE item.order_id = #{orderId} GROUP BY item.id, item.run_id, t.train_no, coach.coach_no, seat.seat_no, item.from_seq, item.to_seq ORDER BY item.id

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket_order o WHERE o.created_at >= #{startDate} AND o.created_at < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS order_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.order_id) FROM payment_record p WHERE p.status = 'SUCCESS' AND p.paid_at >= #{startDate} AND p.paid_at < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS paid_order_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT item.id) FROM payment_record p JOIN order_item item ON item.order_id = p.order_id WHERE p.status = 'SUCCESS' AND p.paid_at >= #{startDate} AND p.paid_at < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM change_record c WHERE c.new_order_item_id = item.id)) AS ticket_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) FROM payment_record p WHERE p.status = 'SUCCESS' AND p.paid_at >= #{startDate} AND p.paid_at < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS gross_sales, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(rr.amount), 0) FROM refund_record rr WHERE rr.status = 'SUCCESS' AND rr.refunded_at >= #{startDate} AND rr.refunded_at < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS refund_amount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(rtn.fee_amount), 0) FROM ticket_return rtn WHERE rtn.status = 'COMPLETED' AND rtn.completed_at >= #{startDate} AND rtn.completed_at < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS return_fee_amount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(f.amount), 0) FROM change_fund_record f WHERE f.status = 'SUCCESS' AND f.fund_type = 'PAYMENT' AND f.processed_at >= #{startDate} AND f.processed_at < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS change_payment_amount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(f.amount), 0) FROM change_fund_record f WHERE f.status = 'SUCCESS' AND f.fund_type = 'REFUND' AND f.processed_at >= #{startDate} AND f.processed_at < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS change_refund_amount

SELECT event.period, SUM(event.paid_order_count) AS paid_order_count, SUM(event.ticket_count) AS ticket_count, SUM(event.gross_sales) AS gross_sales, SUM(event.refund_amount) AS refund_amount, SUM(event.change_payment_amount) AS change_payment_amount, SUM(event.change_refund_amount) AS change_refund_amount, SUM(event.gross_sales + event.change_payment_amount - event.refund_amount - event.change_refund_amount) AS net_revenue FROM ( SELECT AS period, COUNT(DISTINCT p.order_id) AS paid_order_count, SUM((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_item item WHERE item.order_id = p.order_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM change_record c WHERE c.new_order_item_id = item.id))) AS ticket_count, SUM(p.amount) AS gross_sales, 0 AS refund_amount, 0 AS change_payment_amount, 0 AS change_refund_amount FROM payment_record p WHERE p.status = 'SUCCESS' AND p.paid_at >= #{startDate} AND p.paid_at < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY period UNION ALL SELECT , 0, 0, 0, SUM(rr.amount), 0, 0 FROM refund_record rr WHERE rr.status = 'SUCCESS' AND rr.refunded_at >= #{startDate} AND rr.refunded_at < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT , 0, 0, 0, 0, SUM(CASE WHEN f.fund_type = 'PAYMENT' THEN f.amount ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN f.fund_type = 'REFUND' THEN f.amount ELSE 0 END) FROM change_fund_record f WHERE f.status = 'SUCCESS' AND f.processed_at >= #{startDate} AND f.processed_at < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY 1 ) event GROUP BY event.period ORDER BY event.period

SELECT item.from_station_id, fs.name AS from_station_name, item.to_station_id, ts.name AS to_station_name, COUNT(DISTINCT item.id) AS ticket_count, COUNT(DISTINCT item.passenger_id) AS passenger_count, COALESCE(SUM(item.price), 0) AS sales_amount FROM order_item item JOIN station fs ON fs.id = item.from_station_id JOIN station ts ON ts.id = item.to_station_id JOIN train_run r ON r.id = item.run_id JOIN train t ON t.id = r.train_id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payment_record p WHERE p.order_id = item.order_id AND p.status = 'SUCCESS' AND p.paid_at >= #{startDate} AND p.paid_at < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM change_record c WHERE c.new_order_item_id = item.id) AND t.train_no = #{trainNo} AND item.from_station_id = #{fromStationId} AND item.to_station_id = #{toStationId} GROUP BY item.from_station_id, fs.name, item.to_station_id, ts.name ORDER BY ticket_count DESC, sales_amount DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT r.id AS run_id, r.run_date, t.train_no, st.code AS seat_type_code, st.name AS seat_type_name, COUNT(inv.id) AS total_segment_count, SUM(CASE WHEN inv.status = 'SOLD' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sold_segment_count, SUM(CASE WHEN inv.status = 'LOCKED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS locked_segment_count, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN inv.status = 'SOLD' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(inv.id), 0), 2) AS load_factor FROM seat_segment_inventory inv JOIN train_run r ON r.id = inv.run_id JOIN train t ON t.id = r.train_id JOIN train_seat seat ON seat.id = inv.seat_id JOIN train_coach coach ON coach.id = seat.coach_id JOIN seat_type st ON st.id = coach.seat_type_id WHERE r.run_date >= #{startDate} AND r.run_date <= #{endDate} AND t.train_no = #{trainNo} AND st.code = #{seatTypeCode} GROUP BY r.id, r.run_date, t.train_no, st.id, st.code, st.name, st.sort_no ORDER BY r.run_date, t.train_no, st.sort_no

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user u WHERE u.created_at < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS total_users, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user u WHERE u.status = 'ENABLED' AND u.created_at < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS enabled_users, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user u WHERE u.status <> 'ENABLED' AND u.created_at < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS disabled_users, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user u WHERE u.created_at >= #{startDate} AND u.created_at < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS new_users, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.user_id) FROM payment_record p JOIN ticket_order o ON o.id = p.order_id WHERE p.status = 'SUCCESS' AND p.paid_at >= #{startDate} AND p.paid_at < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)) AS active_purchasing_users
